notes:
Lead came through self-serve signup. Customer is a small CS SaaS (11-50 ee). Main friction: users on west coast experience noticeably slower replies than east coast developers. They say 'snappy in dev, slow in production' — likely due to region mismatch and client timeouts. Customer provided example conversation ids and a short transcript (see Fireflies ff_2026-03-02_9876).

Key technical observations from logs: median latency ~220ms (server-side), p95 ~560ms; network RTT from their app hosts to Redwood us-east-1 ~120ms. App uses a 5s client timeout in the browser; occasional tokenization spikes push some requests over timeout.

Quick wins proposed (shared 2026-03-09):
- Align Redwood request region to customer frontend region (suggest us-west-2) — expected reduction ~120-180ms p95.
- Increase client timeout to 10s for chat streaming, or implement streaming/partial responses to avoid 5s hard cutoff.
- Shorten prompt templates: trim system message and set max_tokens per response to 128 for chat flows; encourage use of few-shot examples only when needed.
- Enable prefix/KV caching for repeated context (session-based) to reduce compute cost and latency for follow-up messages.
- Suggest using a smaller quantized model for non-critical channels (email summarization) and reserve larger models for user-facing chat.

Customer concerns / quotes: 'We like the quick onboarding; but users complain about lag. We don't want to move to Dedicated yet — cost-prohibitive.'

Operational asks from customer: SSO (SAML) later in evaluation; audit logs for compliance; simple billing threshold to avoid surprise charges. They asked for a short doc that summarizes region guidance + timeout/prompt best practices (we have a draft in drive).

Next steps: reproduce latency from their staging environment (Jordan + Priya). If repro confirms, propose a one-click region switch for their API key and send a 1-page perf tuning checklist. Schedule 30m tech session week of 2026-03-15.
